headline: GDP Rose 1.9% in Q2, Analysts Expect Annual Growth Below 2% | ČeskéNoviny.cz
summary: The Czech economy grew 1.9% year on year in the second quarter and 0.4% quarter on quarter. The Statistics Office revised the annual figure down 0.1 percentage point from its first estimate.
why: GDP growth is the broadest measure of economic output and shapes central bank policy and investor views on a country's assets.
